notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We have some very exciting news for you all today!

Take your first step into the Qin Dynasty on November 7th, 2022 as Terracotta will be launching on PC! 🎉

[previewyoutube=vQFb42HNyyU;full][/previewyoutube]

We can’t wait for you to experience the Qin dynasty and witness the rise of China from within. 

We’re also excited to announce that Terracotta will be coming to Nintendo Switch sometime in Q1 of 2023!

Thank you all for your support throughout development! We couldn’t have made it this far without you all. With your support, we’ve accomplished a lot, and we can’t wait to show you everything we’ve been working on. Feel free to join our community on Discord, or follow us on Twitter.

notes.title: TERRACOTTA The September Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Did you know that the azure-winged magpie is found in Eastern Asia (such as China, Japan, and Korea)? There’s also a bird in Europe commonly known as the Iberian azure-winged magpie.

This specific bird seems to be suited to the relationship between development team and game’s subject itself, so we were really excited to include the bird in our game!

In narrative segments, we can switch control between player and flock of birds to reach high targets such as kites floating in the air.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807717/11307ca321f198f5c787a378c7c97955f52e840c.gif

In boss battles, where we need to gain some time to operate the puzzle, the birds will become a temporary distraction for the element boss! As you can see in the gif below, the birds represent each of the warriors trapped inside the figures as they are being freed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807717/6c17d5d6afba3961acbc55abfad19c6166110d6d.gif

We really wanted to illustrate the connection between the development team and the game, so we were really excited to discover the azure-winged magpie. 

Thank you, as always, for your support! You can find us on Discord and Twitter. We can’t wait to see you there!

notes.title: TERRACOTTA May Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Our first announcement of the update is that we're excited to announce that we'll be showcased at Indie Live Expo this weekend! Check out Indie Live Expo’s stream showing off the game at the following link:
https://indie.live-expo.games/en/

We’ve also been super hard at work with the game’s aesthetics. We've begun implementing 3D block art to 2D art! The system we have to go from a 3D model to a fixed camera with 2d pixel-perfect is a shader with a triplanar projection and we’re so excited to show off what we’ve done. 

Here's a look at the process:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807717/050324b952319d4aa3f515921e96698a46dc8d74.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807717/0377b85983894f4a7329f54e1b1b2349dc7d88a9.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807717/87d38b5af343f8b1484f79c81c5bd52e8a1b9152.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807717/a119ceec18234efc0f453b991bb0d878bd7742d1.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807717/0d8752ec5f8d776cc9b98e495893e30ee49b7b1a.gif

Isn't that cool?  We've been working pretty hard on this and are super excited for you guys to see the results of our hard work. Don't forget, if you want to join our community, feel free to follow us on Twitter or join our Discord! 

We’ll see you at Indie Live Expo soon!
